cv_summary.text: Computer engineering graduate specializing in renewable energy monitoring and embedded systems.
Proven community leadership in technical education and hackathon organization.

cv_bullets.text: Designed and tested SunTrack solar monitoring prototype on 3 rooftop panels using ESP32 wireless sensors.
Mentored 40 secondary school students in foundational Python programming across 200 volunteer hours.
Assistant coordinator of FSU Tech Club; organized campus hackathon with 120 participants.

essay.text: My goal is to design reliable, low-cost solar energy monitoring systems for small businesses across Nigeria.
During my final year project at FSU, I developed SunTrack, an ESP32 monitoring system tested on rooftop installations.
Beyond technical design, practical technology must uplift local communities.
Over two years, I volunteered 200 hours teaching Python to 40 secondary students, guiding eight to a state science fair.
Joining Aurora's Energy AI Master's and learning from Prof. Mara Quill will equip me to expand smart grid tools in West Africa.
